newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks expected to take a breather.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks expected to take a breather.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are set to take a breather on Wednesday although brokers said a stronger tone on Wall Street overnight could give prices some upside.

"I expect a modest increase in the index this morning but nothing exciting," said Kent Rossiter, institutional sales manager at Nikko Securities. "The U.S. market ended up and there is nothing negative on the Hong Kong front."

The blue-chip Hang Seng Index succumbed to profit-taking on Tuesday, closing down 34.48 points at 14,540.16 after touching an early intra-day record of 14,618.36. The Hang Seng London Reference Index gained 33.37 points to 14,573.53.
